primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: A "responder" was defined as a decrease from baseline to 52 weeks in the participant's BMI z-score of ≥0.2. BMI was calculated using participant's weight and height assessments, using the following formula: BMI = kg/m\^2. The BMI Z-scores were based on the World Health Organization's Child Growth Standards 2007 and indicated the number of standard deviations away from the mean. A Z-score of 0 was equal to the mean of a reference population (i.e., healthy, age and sex-matched individuals). A decrease of BMI Z-score (\< 0) indicated a reduction in BMI from Baseline whereas an increase of BMI-Z score (\> 0) indicated an increase in BMI from Baseline. Baseline was defined as the most recent measurement prior to the first administration of study drug.

groups.description: Participants with POMC/PCSK1/LEPR biallelic mutations collectively referred to as PPL received setmelanotide at a dose of 0.5 mg QD via SC injection for 52 weeks. The dose was escalated by increments of 0.5 mg every 2 weeks, if tolerated, at the dose escalation visits (Weeks 2, 4, and 6) to a maximum dose of 0.5 to 2.0 mg QD with the maximum dose based on body weight.
groups.title: Setmelanotide: PPL Group
